He is considering investing in a municipal bond issued by his local municipality that will yield him 6%. Calculate the taxable equivalent yield of this bond. A. 10.00% B. 3.60% C. 9.23% D. 8.40%
questions_and_answers.answer: The** taxable equivalent yield **of this bond is option C which is 9.23% According to the question, We see that the taxable equivalent yield of the municipal bond is given as equal to=6%/(1-35%)=9.231%. The tax-equivalent yield is the return that an available security would have to yield to rise to the yield on an equivalent comparable tax-exempt bond , like a municipal bond. The computation is an instrument that financial backers can use to look at the profits between a tax-exempt venture and an available other option. Municipal bonds are charge absolved, hence the after-tax yield is equivalent to the pre-tax yield, which is 4.5%.
